terms: Hours and kilometres are counted garage-out to garage-in, from and back to our Kasba office.
Extra kilometres or extra hours beyond the package are charged, whichever comes to more.
Please write the reporting time and kilometres, and the release time and kilometres, on the duty slip in your own handwriting.
Within the city, a driver overtime charge applies after 11 pm and before 6 am.

Outstation trips are charged per kilometre at the car's rate, with a minimum of 250 km a day, plus a daily outstation charge. When the driver's night charge applies, the daily outstation charge is not added.
For overnight outstation trips, please arrange the driver's food and stay. If not arranged, a per-night charge applies.
Interstate taxes, tolls, parking and applicable taxes are paid by the customer.
Local bookings are paid when the car is released. Corporate billing follows your contract.
Online fares are estimates. The invoice is based on actual usage recorded on the duty slip.
Rates may be revised with a rise in fuel prices, by mutual agreement.
